components.responsibility: Stable public Python package export surface for implemented MIRA core components.
components.why_separate: Keeps import compatibility and package presentation separate from mutable-state, routing, transport, and repository-governance implementations.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral canonical structured-state contract and deterministic synthetic adapter semantics.
components.why_separate: Storage mutation, revision, replay, query, and event semantics are reusable below authority routing and API transport.

components.responsibility: Persistent one-authority-per-data-class registry and explicit runtime adapter resolution.
components.why_separate: Canonical authority selection is an integrity boundary independent of storage implementation and client/API transport.

components.responsibility: Same-user API policy, canonical routing, audit, scoped client sessions, and bounded HTTP transport.
components.why_separate: Client-facing policy and transport form one service boundary above canonical authority/storage while remaining provider-neutral and deployment-independent.

components.responsibility: Machine validation of canonical feature dependencies and production component ownership/evidence coverage.
components.why_separate: Repository integrity gates govern source growth and CI evidence rather than participating in mutable product-state authority or runtime provider behavior.
